title: Extracting Bacterial DNA from Filters
author: Natalie Solonenko
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qv8dw9w

steps.title: Add lysis buffer to filter
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of lysis buffer to each filter placed in a 5 mL snap‑cap tube. Lysis buffer composition: 40 mM EDTA, 50 mM Tris, 0.75 M sucrose.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube for 45 min at 37 °C with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Add SDS to 1 % v/v
steps.instruction: Add SDS to a final concentration of 1 % v/v (add 100 µL of 10 % SDS solution to each sample).

steps.title: Incubate at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture for 1 h at 55 °C with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Collect lysate into 2 mL tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the liquid lysate into a clean 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform extraction (repeat twice)
steps.instruction: Perform two consecutive phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extractions:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1) to the tube and mix well.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 mL tube.

steps.title: Chloroform wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL chloroform to the aqueous phase, mix well, centrifuge 5 min at 8000 g, then transfer the upper aqueous phase to the upper reservoir of a 4 mL 100 kDa Amicon concentrator.

steps.title: Concentrate DNA with Amicon filter
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Amicon concentrator at 1000 g until the volume in the upper reservoir is less than 200 µL.

steps.title: Wash concentrator with sterile water (repeat twice)
steps.instruction: Perform two washes of the concentrator:

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL sterile water to the upper reservoir.
Centrifuge at 1000 g until the volume is <200 µL.

steps.title: Collect concentrated DNA
steps.instruction: Collect the final concentrate from the upper reservoir and transfer it to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit HS assay
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using the Qubit High‑Sensitivity DNA assay according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
